#   llama-eval-callback -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00005.gguf \

# Layers 0-3 only. THIS CAPTURE EXISTS FOR THE PATHS SHORTER PROMPTS CANNOT REACH.
#
# What fires at 165 tokens that does not at 5:
#   attn_hca            90 rows   HCA attention, on all 20 odd layers
#   hca_state_compress 285 rows   the HCA compressor actually compressing
#   csa_state_compress 225 rows   (CSA compresses at 5 too, ratio 4)
# Only layers 0-1 remain attn_raw (12 rows), as they are the only Raw layers.
#
# What STILL does not fire, and why a longer capture is needed:
#   the indexer's selection. lid_score_masked-2 is {256, 165}, so n_lid is
#   still 256 and n_top_k = min(256, 512) = 256 -- every slot selected, mask
#   unchanged. Needs n_lid > 512, so >512 completed blocks, so >2048 tokens.
#
# Shapes are unchanged from the short captures: n_kv stays 256 per half and
# hca_k_all is {512, 1, 512}, identical to csa_k_all. So the attention half of
# HCA is the CSA one with a different compressor feeding it.
